title: Sewing Machine Repairs in the East Midlands: Your Options
description: Sewing machine repairs and servicing across the East Midlands: workshop servicing in Leicester, industrial call-outs, collection and delivery, and what to ask.
h1: Sewing machine repairs across the East Midlands
intro: Whether you are in Leicester, Loughborough, Nottingham, Derby or Northampton, here is how to get a domestic or industrial machine repaired.
cardText: Workshop servicing, industrial call-outs, collection and delivery.

sections.html: PK Sewing Machines services and repairs domestic and industrial machines in its Leicester workshop at 415 St Saviours Road, with servicing listed from £35 on its website.
For workrooms and production environments, PKSM offers on-site industrial call-outs across the East Midlands, which keeps downtime short.
If you can’t bring a machine in, PKSM says collection and delivery can be arranged, with fees depending on the machine, location and distance. Ask for a quote.

• Do you work on my make and model?
  • Is there a fixed service price, and what does it include?
  • Will you call me before doing extra work?
  • Do you stock the parts, and how long will it take?
Many faults are fixed by rethreading and a new needle. See our troubleshooting guide. The East Midlands has deep machinery know-how thanks to its hosiery heritage.
